harness_repair: Initial focused test timed out on a new Stage5 asset wait because native child RAF was trapped. Explicit polling=50 plus stageLoadBegin(5) fixed the harness; no production change for that timeout.
limits: Recording omits Stage4 highway/miniboss and the alternate Rebel route.
Targeted native regressions do not constitute a new full-campaign playthrough at every difficulty.
prior_verification_gap: Earlier core checks accepted any visible hit-pixel change and expiry; the rectangle passed. New checks exclude surrounding-hull changes and require surviving blue core pixels. Embedded helper and edge-hull radar cases were also previously absent.
